To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) The vector space model with word-based indexing is the best approach for spoken document retrieval.

(1) the use of subwords in spoken document retrieval is a promising approach; (2) the HMM/Ngram approach is superior to the vector space model approach for spoken document retrieval; (3) the HMM-based approach is superior to both the vector space model and the Ngram-based approaches for spoken document retrieval, and (4) for Mandarin Chinese spoken language, the use of subword units is better than the use of words.

(1) for the vector space model approach, subword indexing outperforms word indexing; (2) for the HMM/Ngram approach, word indexing outperforms subword indexing; (3) the HMM/N gram approach outperforms the vector space model in all experiments.
